description: This file defines the DocumentRevision class in a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM module. It is a model class representing document revisions, including properties, database interactions, and logic related to document revision management.

classes.name: DocumentRevision
classes.description: A model class representing a document revision, handling data persistence, retrieval, and related document information within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current document revision object to the database and updates related document entries, with optional notification.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns a string summary (filename) for the document revision.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves a document revision record from the database by ID.

methods.name: is_authenticated
methods.description: Checks if the current document revision is authenticated.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Fills in additional data for list views, delegating to detail fields.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Populates detailed fields such as document name and latest revision info related to this revision.

methods.name: getDocumentRevisionNameForDisplay
methods.description: Generates a display name for the document revision, incorporating the revision number and file extension.

methods.name: fill_document_name_revision
methods.description: Fetches and sets the document's name and latest revision based on document ID.

methods.name: list_view_parse_additional_sections
methods.description: Allows extension or customization of list view sections.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares and returns data for list view display, including file URL.

methods.name: get_document_revision_name
methods.description: Static method to fetch revision label for a given revision ID.

methods.name: get_document_revisions
methods.description: Static method to list all revision IDs and labels for a given document.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Checks if this bean implements a specific interface, e.g., 'FILE'.
